subject: Next steps: procurement path & packaging options for Vega Health
messages:
From: Aisha Rahman <aisha.rahman@redwood.ai>
To: Jordan Ellis <jordan.ellis@vegahealth.com>
Cc: Marta Lopez <marta.lopez@vegahealth.com>
Date: Mon, 14 Jun 2026 16:05:00 -0700
Subject: Quick recap + procurement questions (hosted vs dedicated vs private)

Jordan — great to meet today, thanks for walking through the Vega Health use case. Short recap and a few procurement questions so we can route the right commercial path and get you a clean quote.

Recap (from our call)
- Primary workload: near-real-time patient note streaming + embeddings for search (peak 35 req/s, typical <10).
- Data sensitivity: PHI-adjacent; you flagged desire for audit logs and customer-managed keys in the long term.
- Timeline: pilot in Q3, production in Q4 if procurement clears.

Procurement & commercial questions (what we need to know from you)
1) Billing flow: do you require a Purchase Order (PO) and Net-30 terms, or can the pilot run on card? If PO, who is the procurement contact (name + email)?
2) Marketplace preference: does your org mandate purchases through a cloud marketplace (AWS/GCP/Azure) for SSO/invoicing reasons?
3) Commit vs on-demand: are you open to a small committed monthly commit for discount during the pilot, or must everything be strictly on-demand?
4) Compliance docs: do you need SOC2 attestation, data processing addendum, or an encryption/KMS attestation up-front for vendor approval?

Attached: Redwood_Pricing_Options_v3.xlsx and Hosted_vs_Dedicated_Comparison.pdf — those show pricing bands for Hosted (on-demand), Dedicated (reserved pool + commit), and Private (VPC/on-prem). I called out the expected fit for your peak in the pricing sheet.

Next steps
- Jordan: confirm procurement contact and whether PO/marketplace is required.
- We (Redwood): hold a short call with procurement if useful; draft a PO-ready quote depending on the preferred path.

Thanks — I’ll hold off on sending a formal quote until I have your procurement flow.

Best,
Aisha Rahman
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
---
Attachments: Redwood_Pricing_Options_v3.xlsx (spreadsheet), Hosted_vs_Dedicated_Comparison.pdf (pdf)
From: Jordan Ellis <jordan.ellis@vegahealth.com>
To: Aisha Rahman <aisha.rahman@redwood.ai>
Cc: Marta Lopez <marta.lopez@vegahealth.com>, procurement@vegahealth.com
Date: Tue, 15 Jun 2026 09:24:00 -0400
Subject: Re: Quick recap + procurement questions (hosted vs dedicated vs private)

Aisha — thanks for the recap and for the attachments, super helpful. Answering your questions below: 

1) Billing: For pilot we prefer to run on PO with Net-30; card purchases are less likely to get approval for projects involving PHI.
2) Marketplace: Procurement prefers marketplace purchases when available, but it is not a strict blocker if vendor has acceptable terms and can provide invoice/PO processing.
3) Commit vs on-demand: For pilot we cannot commit to a long-term spend yet; a small monthly commit (1–3 months) with the option to convert is acceptable if there's a clear cap.
4) Compliance: We need SOC2 report and DPAs; for KMS we need details on key management options (bring-your-own-key preferred).

Procurement lead: Marta Lopez <marta.lopez@vegahealth.com> (cc'd). Marta will coordinate legal/finance review. Our rough procurement timeline: internal review in 2 weeks, PO issuance in 3–4 weeks if everything looks okay.

Happy to schedule a short call with Marta next week. Please include a line-item quote that explicitly lists Hosted vs Dedicated pricing and what the commitments buy you (SLA, throughput guarantee, dedicated tenancy).

Thanks,
Jordan
Director of Product Integrations | Vega Health
From: Aisha Rahman <aisha.rahman@redwood.ai>
To: Connor O'Brien <connor.obrien@redwood.ai>, Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 15 Jun 2026 10:02:00 -0700
Subject: Fwd: Quick recap + procurement questions — pricing ask from Vega Health

Connor / Priyom — forwarding Jordan's reply. Key asks: PO/Net-30 for pilot, marketplace preferred but not required, small short-term commit ok, SOC2 & KMS/BYOK details required. Procurement timeline: internal review ~2 weeks, PO in 3–4 weeks.

Questions from our side:
- Pricing shape: recommend we prepare two PO-ready quotes: (A) Hosted on-demand with line items for pilot usage and optional committed discount conversion; (B) Dedicated small-reservation (e.g., 1 x p4/reserved pool equivalent) with monthly commit discount and SLA. Please add a one-page note for Marta showing what commit buys (throughput guarantee, dedicated tenancy, audit/log retention).
- Marketplace listing: do we have an AWS Marketplace SKU we can offer? If yes, what is the lead time to enable invoicing via marketplace for a new customer?
- Compliance bundle: include SOC2 attestation + DPA + KMS BYOK notes. Can we produce a short KMS integration note (one page) for procurement?

Connor — can you take pricing drafts? Priyom — can you pull the compliance artifacts and a 1-page KMS BYOK note we can attach to the quote? I'll coordinate the call with Marta next week.

Thanks,
Aisha
